# Pitch Anchor

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:PitchAnchor`](gmeow-PitchAnchor.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/PitchAnchor>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A binding between one degree of a [`TuningSystem`](gmeow-TuningSystem.md) and a physical frequency in an explicit acoustic frame (e.g., A440 vs Baroque A415). Hz is never asserted directly on a [`PitchValue`](gmeow-PitchValue.md); it is reached only through fnPitchToFrequency(value, anchor) (Principles 11, 12).
